semantic.justification: Ports the supported Writer script/language default-font decision and keeps output-device resolution behind an injected contract. Task135: Stores the selected device adapter family in the actual font value, matching native OutputDevice OnlyOne selection responsibility; complete device service remains unported. Task135 preserves the five native SvxFontItem fields and original value defaults/constructors/copies/setters/equality/hash using existing SAL/o3tl. Writer state and ODF consumers use the single shared value owner; browser presentation and resource aliases stay at their existing boundaries. Native Any FontDescriptor, localized presentation, full font/device/config services and Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing status/history and conscious save/open/recovery deviations are retained; no broad parity promotion or custom lifetime engine.
